blocks.text: Greenhouse effect woh qudrati amal hai jis mein zameen ki fiza ki gases, greenhouse gases (GHGs), zameen ki satah se nikalne wali garmi qaid karti hain: yeh dhoop ko guzarne deti lekin garmi ko seedha khala mein jane se rokti hain, jis se zameen zindagi ke liye kaafi garam rehti hai.

In gases, khaas kar CO2, ki miqdar wazeh taur par barh gayi hai, zyada tar machinein chalane, gaariyan chalane, ghar garam karne aur bijli banane mein fossil fuels ke istemal se. Fiza ki yeh barhi hui ghair qudrati garmi insani sargarmiyon ka mahol par sab se bara manfi asar hai.

blocks.alt: Do panel. Qudrati greenhouse effect: dhoop greenhouse gases ki patli teh se zameen ki satah tak jati; wapas aane wali garmi kuch qaid aur kuch teen teeron mein nikal jati. Barha hua greenhouse effect: gases ki teh moti (zyada CO2, CH4, N2O), zyada garmi qaid aur garmi ka sirf aik teer nikalta.
blocks.caption: Qudrati aur barha hua greenhouse effect (Figure 25.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Fiza ki greenhouse gases dhoop ko guzarne deti lekin zameen ki satah se nikalne wali garmi ka kuch hissa qaid kar leti hain, jis se zameen zindagi ke liye kaafi garam rehti hai: qudrati greenhouse effect. Machinon, gaariyon, garmi aur bijli ke liye fossil fuels jalane aur jangalat katne se in gases, khaas kar carbon dioxide, ki miqdar barh gayi hai; moti chadar zyada garmi qaid karti aur fiza ki barhi hui ghair qudrati garmi, global warming, paida hoti hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baatein
blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq World Meteorological Organization ke hawale se sanati daur se pehle CO2 taqreeban 280 parts per million thi aur 2026 mein 428 ppm tak pohanchi aur barh rahi hai; aalami ausat darja hararat 1900 se taqreeban 1 C barha hai. Pakistan aalami greenhouse emissions ka 1% se kam deta hai lekin mausami tabdeeli se sab se zyada mutasir das mulkon mein shamil hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar greenhouse effect bilkul na ho to zameen ka kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Garmi seedha khala mein chali jati aur zameen maujooda zindagi ke liye bohat thandi hoti; masla barha hua effect hai, qudrati nahi.

items: Qudrati greenhouse effect zameen ko zindagi ke liye garam rakhta.
Fossil fuels aur jangalat ki katai ki izafi CO2 ise barhati aur global warming laati.
